    StartersMud-camo bean dipBlack bean dip with feta, coriander and green chilliHow to make it800g black beans (2 tins), drained2 garlic cloves1 tsp ground cumin2 limes80g feta, crumbled1 bunch coriander1 green chilli, sliced1 bag corn chipsBlitz the beans with the garlic, cumin and lime juice until smooth.Spread in a bowl and top with the feta, coriander and green chilli.Serve with the corn chips.Billy's plantain chipsThin crisp green plantain chips with lime saltHow to make it3 green plantains1 L vegetable oil1 lime, zested1 tsp sea salt flakesPeel the plantains and slice very thin on a mandoline.Fry in the vegetable oil at 175°C in batches until crisp, about 2 minutes each.Mix the flaky salt with the lime zest and toss through the hot chips.Blain's chilli beef jerkyBlain's chewing habit, but beefHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thin-sliced topside marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar and dried chilli, slow-dried until chewy with a slow-building heat.Freeze 800g topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick across the grain.Mix 100ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp cayenne and 1 tsp cracked pepper.Marinate the beef overnight.Pat dry and lay on wire racks over trays.Dry at 70°C with the oven door slightly open for 4 hours until leathery but bendy.Cool and store airtight.Fried yuca with lime and saltBetter than what Blain chews, trust us.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsChopper pad steakSmoky paprika rump grilled hot, with sharp green chimichurriHow to make it4 rump steaks2 tsp smoked paprika1 bunch parsley2 garlic cloves3 tbsp red wine vinegar100ml extra virgin olive oil1 tsp chilli flakessalt and pepper, to tasteRub the steaks with salt, pepper and smoked paprika.Chop the parsley and garlic and mix with the vinegar, oil and chilli flakes.Grill over high heat, turning once.Rest the steaks, then spoon over the chimichurri.Val Verde achiote chicken, rice and beansThe jungle villageHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken thighs braised in achiote, orange and sofrito until tender, with black beans, white rice and sweet fried plantain.Fry 1 diced onion, 1 diced red capsicum and 3 garlic cloves in oil for 8 minutes.Add 1 tbsp achiote paste, 1 tsp cumin, the juice of 2 oranges and 200ml chicken stock.Add 1kg chicken thighs, cover and simmer 35 minutes until tender.Cook 300g rice.Warm a drained 400g tin black beans with a pinch of cumin.Slice 2 ripe plantains on the angle and fry in oil until caramelised.SweetsMud cakeDense chocolate mud cake with ganache dragged like mudHow to make it400g dark chocolate250g butter4 eggs300g caster sugar150g plain flour30g cocoa150ml thickened creamHeat the oven to 160°C and line a cake tin. Melt part of the chocolate with the butter and let it cool slightly.Whisk in the eggs and sugar, then fold in the flour and cocoa.Bake until a skewer comes out with just a few crumbs, then cool in the tin.Heat the cream, melt in the remaining chocolate, pour over the cake and drag with a fork.DrinksVal Verde jungle rum punchDark rum, passionfruit, pineapple and lime shaken with a dash of grenadine, poured over crushed ice and topped with grated nutmeg.How to make it180ml dark rum120ml pineapple juice4 passionfruits3 limes (60ml juice)20ml grenadine1 small pineapple1 whole nutmeg1 bag crushed ice2 cups ice, for shakingJuice the limes and scoop out the passionfruit pulp. Cut pineapple wedges for garnish.Shake the rum, pineapple juice, passionfruit, lime juice and grenadine with ice for 15 seconds.Strain into tumblers packed with crushed ice, grate nutmeg on top and garnish with a pineapple wedge.Fresh green coconut with limeDrink up.
